candidateFindings.question: How narrow was the victory?
candidateFindings.factual_result: PSOE led PP by 512 votes and 2.0257 pp.
candidateFindings.safe_client_wording: PSOE-A won a very narrow municipal plurality.
candidateFindings.wording_to_avoid: A mandate caused by any single territory or group.

candidateFindings.question: Where was the advantage built?
candidateFindings.factual_result: PSOE exceeded PP in 24 of 37 sections; PP exceeded PSOE in 13.
candidateFindings.safe_client_wording: The PSOE–PP balance varied sharply by territory.
candidateFindings.wording_to_avoid: Residents within a section voted alike.

candidateFindings.question: Which winners changed?
candidateFindings.safe_client_wording: Seven comparable territories changed leading party.
candidateFindings.key_limitation: Spatial harmonisation; one family below 90% overlap.

candidateFindings.question: PSOE territorial expansion
candidateFindings.factual_result: PSOE led 11 families in 2019 and 18 in 2023.
candidateFindings.safe_client_wording: PSOE expanded from 11 to 18 comparable territories.

candidateFindings.question: PP territorial contraction
candidateFindings.factual_result: PP led 16 families in 2019 and 10 in 2023.
candidateFindings.safe_client_wording: PP contracted from 16 to 10 comparable territories.
candidateFindings.wording_to_avoid: PP voters necessarily moved to another party.

candidateFindings.question: Cs decline and PSOE
candidateFindings.safe_client_wording: Cs decline and PSOE change coincided territorially to the reported degree.

candidateFindings.question: Cs decline and PP
candidateFindings.safe_client_wording: Cs decline and PP change coincided territorially to the reported degree.

candidateFindings.question: VOX relationship
candidateFindings.factual_result: PSOE change↔VOX change Pearson -0.059; PP change↔VOX change Pearson 0.344.
candidateFindings.safe_client_wording: VOX and PSOE/PP changes showed territorial associations.
candidateFindings.wording_to_avoid: VOX split the vote or caused the result.

candidateFindings.question: Por Mi Pueblo
candidateFindings.factual_result: PMP obtained 5.5863% municipally; no valid 2019 predecessor.
candidateFindings.metrics: raw candidacy 2023 share and section correlations
candidateFindings.safe_client_wording: PMP presence coincided with a different competitive structure where supported by section evidence.

candidateFindings.question: Turnout change
candidateFindings.safe_client_wording: Turnout and party changes co-varied territorially.

candidateFindings.question: Demographic context
candidateFindings.factual_result: Current Block C context was aggregated to 28 families and tested against electoral change.
candidateFindings.safe_client_wording: Territories with different current profiles evolved differently only where numerically supported.

candidateFindings.question: First-time voters
candidateFindings.factual_result: First-time voter contribution cannot be identified from available aggregate data.
candidateFindings.safe_client_wording: The available evidence cannot identify first-time-voter contribution.
candidateFindings.wording_to_avoid: Under-30 residents are first-time voters or voted for PSOE.

candidateFindings.question: Strongest PSOE gains
candidateFindings.factual_result: Top ten families are reported with party, turnout, volatility and context deltas.
candidateFindings.safe_client_wording: These comparable territories recorded the largest PSOE gains.

candidateFindings.question: Strongest PP losses
candidateFindings.factual_result: Top ten families are reported with party, turnout, volatility and context deltas.
candidateFindings.safe_client_wording: These comparable territories recorded the largest PP declines.

rejectedHypotheses.reason: Aggregate territorial results cannot identify individual flows.
No longitudinal voting-age cohort; under-30 is not a first-time-voter proxy.
No valid predecessor; LOCAL aggregate cannot establish candidacy identity.
Context variables are mostly current/2023–2024 and descriptive.

dataQuality.check: harmonised party votes reconcile to municipal totals
